dialogues.speaker: Library Rules
dialogues.text: "There were several editions of the library rules, but none of them were particularly useful."

dialogues.speaker: Library Rules
dialogues.text: "So all unnecessary rules were abandoned in this edition. All users of the library should obey the following rules:"

dialogues.speaker: Library Rules
dialogues.text: "1. Please keep quiet in the library."

dialogues.speaker: Library Rules
dialogues.text: "2. Please do not damage the books."

dialogues.speaker: Library Rules
dialogues.text: "3. Please remember to return your books on time."

dialogues.speaker: Library Rules
dialogues.text: "I believe everyone knows how we deal with violations, so it will not be repeated here."

dialogues.speaker: Library Rules
dialogues.text: "We hope everyone can abide by the above rules and make good use of the library."
